faq.realProfitA: Paper profit is the selling price minus the purchase price. Real profit is what you actually have left once you have bought the same goods again. In a market where prices keep rising, the two are very different.
faq.rateQ: Where does the price-rise figure come from, and how accurate is it?
faq.rateA: From three things: the purchase prices you record yourself, how fast your product’s category is rising nationally, and the dollar (if the goods are imported). It is always an estimate, never a certainty — which is why Sooda says “about” everywhere, and why “Why this number?” shows how much of it came from where.
faq.inflationQ: I don’t know the inflation rate. Is that a problem?
faq.inflationA: No. Sooda has a default rate that comes from the national figures, and you can change it in Settings. And if you know the new purchase price, you don’t need inflation at all: just enter it directly.
faq.storageA: On this phone, and only here. No account, no server, and nothing is sent from your device. The only thing Sooda fetches from the internet is a public rates file from its own site — and you can turn that off in Settings too.
faq.phoneQ: What happens if I change phones?
faq.phoneA: Take a backup file from Settings and restore it on the new phone. Because the data lives on the phone, without a backup it goes when the browser is cleared.
faq.freeA: Yes, completely free and open source, under the MIT licence.
faq.practiceQ: Do the lessons touch my real products?
faq.practiceA: No. Every lesson runs on a separate practice shop that is deleted when you close it. Your products, history and settings stay exactly as they were.
